evaluation_status.definition: NON_FINAL_EVALUATION; no independent final test partition.

release_status.definition: Local review only; sharing/training approval has not been granted.

row_id.definition: Unique run_id:origin_sim_s. Never an input feature.

run_id.definition: One of four V2_Qxx qualified arms.

weather_id.definition: bestest_air_v090_weather; same source weather file, distinct windows.

group_id.definition: Matched weather/initialization group; keep both paired arms together.

control_policy.definition: native or scheduled_variation; metadata, not automatically a model feature.

partition.definition: development for every row. No train/test split is supplied.

origin_sim_s.definition: Prediction origin; not UTC or a real calendar date.

support_start_sim_s.definition: origin-2100; earliest required past electrical support.

initialization_id.definition: Unique fresh initialization per arm; warmup values are not examples.

origin_cutoff_order.definition: Known information cutoff; not an input feature.
